faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by Tezpur University for the Female Security Supervisor post under advertisement number 30 / 2026 on a contract basis in Tezpur, Assam.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Female Security Supervisor post?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Female Security Supervisor position at Tezpur University as per the official recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q3. What is the required educational qualification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a graduate degree in any discipline from a recognized Indian university with excellent communication skills in Assamese, English, and Hindi along with required retirement status.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any prior experience required to apply?
faq.answer: Yes, applicants must be retired officers of not below the rank of Sub Inspector or J.C.O. from Assam Police Battalion, RPF, Armed Forces, or Paramilitary Forces with at least three years of security service experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for the Female Security Supervisor post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 62 years, with applicable age relaxations of up to 5 years for experienced candidates from higher educational institutes of repute.

faq.question: Q6. What salary will be provided to the selected candidate?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Female Security Supervisor position will receive a fixed monthly salary of Rs. 35,000/- Per Month.

faq.question: Q7. What is the last date to apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application via email or post to Tezpur University is 20 October 2026.

faq.question: Q8. How can I apply for the Tezpur University Female Security Supervisor job?
faq.answer: Interested eligible candidates need to apply by sending their filled application in the prescribed format along with relevant documents via email to [email protected] or by post.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection procedure for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Female Security Supervisor position involves short-listing of applications followed by a personal interaction session.

faq.question: Q10. Where should the physical applications be sent if not emailing?
faq.answer: Physical applications can be sent to the Registrar i/c, Tezpur University, Napaam, Tezpur-784028, District Sonitpur, Assam on or before the specified last date.
